episodes.163606: Instability caused by an upper air disturbance triggered heavy showers over portions of the Big Island and Maui.  The precipitation produced small stream and drainage ditch flooding, and ponding on roadways.  No serious property damage or injuries were reported.
episodes.164268: Excessive rain in the northern Cascade Mountains and southern British Columbia led to rising rivers in northern Washington in mid-November. The Okanogan and Similkameen Rivers reached minor flood stage. Most impacts of the flooding rivers were on flood plain and pasture lands.

events.narrative: There was a minor flood on the Okanogan River with a majority of the flood impacts found north of Tonasket. In this area, the flood plain is wide and flood water is able to spread. This includes a lot of pasture land or swampy areas near the river. In Ellisforde, there was a farm that had flooding on the property, which included pasture lands and outbuildings. The Okanogan River gage near Tonasket, at minor flood stage, crested at 15.48' at 12:00 PST on November 17th.
